verdicts.small_FT_vs_frontier: small telemetry-FT models (even 1B) reach F1 ~0.98 (P~0.99, R~0.97) -> beat the whole frontier panel (Claude best at 0.875); RQ3 headline replicated + extended to 1B/3.8B/7B. Faithfulness without abstention, independent of scale.
verdicts.multitask_vs_single: multi_phi 0.980 ~= strat_phi 0.979 (TIE). Multitask did NOT dilute the strategy task; it matches single-task AND also does commentary -> strictly more capable at equal F1. User's bet that multitask is superior: WON. (The earlier 'multitask lost 0.579' was a scoring artifact.)
verdicts.cross_task_transfer: commentary-FT transfers to strategy better than expected (Mistral 0.809, Phi 0.742, Llama 0.572) -> commentary supervision is partially transferable; rises with base capability.
verdicts.cautionary_tale: Batched LLM-extractor scoring under rate-limiting silently returned 0.0 for failed extractions, deflating later files and inverting the multitask verdict. Score with retries/low concurrency. A low coverage number can be a measurement artifact, not a worse model -- the paper's own thesis applied to its own evaluation.
verdicts.claude_clean_vs_exploratory: Clean Bedrock-API Claude = F1 0.809 (P0.893/R0.739, no abstention, 8.3 claims/inst) vs the subagent-exploratory 0.875: the Claude Code harness context inflated the exploratory by ~0.07 (recall 0.879->0.739). Use 0.809 (clean) for the paper. Even the faithfulness-reputed frontier family, queried cleanly, lands mid-panel and far below FT-on-oracle (~0.98).
